note: v2 promotion gate stage3 -> stage4 (measurable, provisional policy). Thresholds are floors set BEFORE the full-budget run, not predictions of quality: the newly taught capabilities (knowledge, comprehension) must clear a real floor on the independent held-out test, prior capabilities (reasoning, language) must not regress below their replay floor, and validation loss must stay low. Tighten after the first full 50M run on a runner (docs/training/tinymind-v2-50m-plan.md). Categories referenced are guaranteed present in stage3's held-out test set (primary + replay).
